verdict.rationale: Postmark's docs reference an 'idempotency pattern' example for Node/TypeScript (postmark-docs-10) and per-recipient MessageID tracking in batch sends (postmark-docs-11), suggesting developers can build deduplication logic, but there is no evidence of a native idempotency-key parameter or Postmark-guaranteed duplicate-suppression semantics on the /email endpoint itself. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a request-level idempotency key or explicit no-double-send guarantee on retry, independent confirmation that retried failed sends are safely deduped server-side.
